items.title: How fast does the noise-to-signal ratio get worse as flags are added?
items.description: The upload widget only ever needs 5 meaningful states, no matter how it's implemented. Drag the number of independent boolean flags used to track state and watch how small a fraction of the resulting combinations are actually meaningful — at 4 flags, this reproduces L2's exact 16-combination, 31.25%-meaningful reading.
items.compute: const total = Math.pow(2, params.flagCount); return { totalCombinations: total, meaningfulPercent: (5 / total) * 100 };

outputs.label: Percent of combinations that are actually meaningful
